I'm sorry, Jon. Your B30 is late, and I know it's been a long wait since July.

Your order Shop···· (the B30 and your free Power Kit) hasn't shipped yet. It's in batch 1, which left the factory and is being checked in at our US warehouse now. Your Power Kit is already there. Both go out together once the B30 is in, and the tracking number comes to your email. We sent you an update with factory photos on November 3.

You can follow the batch here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I've asked the team to confirm your exact ship date. If you stay in the chat, one of them will reply here, and if you step away it comes by email.
